title: Docker Image Publishing Infrastructure
description:
Set up GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) publishing for all chronos services.

## Goals
- Publish multi-platform Docker images (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) to GHCR
- Automate builds on release tags and main branch pushes
- Enable easy adoption without requiring local toolchains
- Include proper licensing (MIT) for open source compliance

## Services to Publish
- chronos-core (Rust) - Already has Dockerfile
- chronos-query-service (Elixir) - Already has Dockerfile  
- chronos-control-plane (Go) - Needs Dockerfile
- chronos-web (Next.js) - Needs Dockerfile
- mcp-server-elixir (Elixir) - Needs Dockerfile

## Registry
ghcr.io/all-source-os/chronos-*
close_reason: Docker publishing infrastructure complete - all 7 tasks done

title: US-001: Add MIT LICENSE file to repository root
description:
As a project maintainer, I need a LICENSE file for open source compliance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create /LICENSE file with MIT license text
- [ ] Include correct copyright holder (AllSource Team)
- [ ] Include current year (2025)
- [ ] Verify license is recognized by GitHub
close_reason: Created MIT LICENSE file at repo root

title: US-002: Create Dockerfile for control-plane (Go)
description:
As a DevOps engineer, I need a Dockerfile for the Go control-plane service.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create /apps/control-plane/Dockerfile with multi-stage build
- [ ] Use golang:1.21-alpine for build stage
- [ ] Use distroless or alpine for runtime (minimal image)
- [ ] Run as non-root user
- [ ] Include health check endpoint
- [ ] Image builds successfully with: docker build -t chronos-control-plane apps/control-plane
close_reason: Created Dockerfile for control-plane with multi-stage build

title: US-005: Add .dockerignore files to all services
description:
As a DevOps engineer, I need .dockerignore files to optimize Docker builds.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create /apps/core/.dockerignore (exclude target/, .git, etc.)
- [ ] Create /apps/query-service/.dockerignore (exclude _build/, deps/, .git)
- [ ] Create /apps/control-plane/.dockerignore (exclude vendor if not used, .git)
- [ ] Create /apps/web/.dockerignore (exclude node_modules/, .next/, .git)
- [ ] Create /apps/mcp-server-elixir/.dockerignore (exclude _build/, deps/, .git)
- [ ] Each ignores: .git, .env*, *.md (except required), test artifacts

title: US-006: Create GitHub Actions workflow for Docker publishing
description:
As a DevOps engineer, I need automated Docker builds and publishing to GHCR.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create /.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml
- [ ] Trigger on: push to main, release tags (v*), manual dispatch
- [ ] Build all 5 services using matrix strategy
- [ ] Multi-platform builds: linux/amd64, linux/arm64
- [ ] Push to ghcr.io/all-source-os/chronos-{service}
- [ ] Tag images with: version, sha-short, latest (for main)
- [ ] Include OCI labels (title, description, license, source)
- [ ] Use docker/build-push-action with buildx
- [ ] Cache layers using GitHub Actions cache
close_reason: Created GitHub Actions workflow for multi-platform Docker publishing to GHCR
